# Deployment Rules
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Environment Order

```text
Local or development -> Staging -> Review -> Production
```

Every change is validated on staging before production consideration. Production deployment requires the approved launch gates and explicit release authority.

## Required Before Production

- Supported runtime, database, storage, and deployment method are recorded.
- HTTPS, domain, backups, restore test, uptime monitoring, and incident ownership are confirmed.
- No critical access or security defects remain.
- Required program content is loaded and checked.
- Participant testing is complete.
- SharePoint remains available until the new application is accepted.

## Release Safety

- Use Git as the source history for application code.
- Keep deployment steps repeatable and documented.
- Record the commit or source version used for each staging or production release.
- Define rollback or fallback steps before release.
- Do not place production credentials in Git or validation files.
